_comment: Tongue mucosa (Phase07 7.5). SUBSURFACE; rougher than the gums (the papillae), moist.
name: Tongue_Natural_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: Colour: MakeHuman system assets (CC0, makehuman_system_assets_cc0.zip sha256 b542127a...0107), mean linear colour of the region in its texture; the texture bakes in some shading (tongue01_diffuse.png). Roughness 0.5: the papillae. Coat 0.3 at 0.2, IOR 1.336: saliva. Scatter as skin (Physically Based Skin I-III's radius, anisotropy 0.8, `subsurface_color` = the albedo), since mucosa and sclera are soft tissue of the same kind; no measured radius exists for them.
